notes.title: Alpha 6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/0f25b5202604323df871bd8ca453bd246b5f4ae5.png"]
Major Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where a player's camera would get broken and flash (Report if this happens to you)
NEW Chronos Arena Art Update
Mainline


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/6427b8c5fbc309cde0e85f1b26cb68294aa857d3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/699ab4cc1e5ded0f65c6cfdce3df82102e5783ab.png"][/carousel]


Breakpoint


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/a438dada8e9402507577614ccd967b942482f5ee.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/9d1fc103b58858047a7406710432ceb2b6337b75.png"][/carousel]



NEW Champion Stats
Right-click a champion to see all the details and stats

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/2c247b3a3849a71c7713a0d5bce1104995bc8f25.png"]
NEW Summon Stats
Right-click a summon to see all the details and stats

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/172c83340c3ccd9712ad68a5eea73b38150fa151.png"]
UPDATE Game Mode
Players can no longer perform any actions while in the pregame dugout phase.

The following changes around the game mode are to balance some inconsistencies we have been seeing with the flow of the game.

We want to discourage players from diving at the goalie, so we are making an update to the goalie's targeting, movement, and damage.

We want to encourage playing summons more strategically around the Goalie to get maximum damage.

The goalie not clearing summons on KO really helps the push stay active and incentivizes the defenders to actually defend instead of just letting the goalie go down to clear the summons.

Keeping the mana aura in play all game helps balance out the goalie not clearing summons on KO.

Overall, these changes will help the defender and the attacker in different ways throughout a match.

Goalie

Movement speed changed from 400 → 600

Damage changed from 45 → 75

No longer clears summons on Goalie KO

Targeting now prioritizes summons

Can switch targets after each attack

Counter added on the HUD to show how many times a Goalie has been KO’d

Core health changed from 3000 → 4000

Aura

Is no longer attached to the Goalie

Aura is now stationary around the Goalie/ Core spawn point all the time

When the Core is broken, it will clear all enemy summons in the Aura

Summons can NOT target the Goalie unless they are within the aura

Champion KOs

Now grants 10% ultimate charge

Champions now respawn with 4 mana

Wild Card Visual Update

Is now an in-world timer

Health of the Wild Card has been added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/a2ca02155e21f5f7e7a15ca362f89f0ee91dff42.png"]

Tab Screen Update

Full Decks are now displayed

The screen is now a toggle

Hover cards for details

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/94bbab01e582b31f88049f2f46d2e18415f0798f.png"]

Victory Screen Update

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/de4b52e38a7f77e45c491eac9d6e7151927eaa48.png"]

Post Game AAR Update

Additional stats have been added

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/1fc0b6fc532a8f9776c42d21bc7df7fe34fc462e.png"]
Knockback
Knockback is getting a nerf in the damage category because its strength is in the crowd control, not the damage. Anything that has knockback will see a damage increase because of this.

Fall distance damage changed from .03 → .01
NEW Guardian Keyword
When a guardian is the target of a champion's attack, it will take 100% damage, and everything else hit will take 50% damage.

When a guardian is not the main target of a champion's attack, it will take 50% damage.

Summons With the Keyword

Infernus

Janz

Floraphant

Gorrit
Summons
Fixed an issue where they would not target correctly on ramps
Hornelius
Movement speed changed from 600 → 700

Attack cooldown changed from 4.5s → 3s

Damage changed from 5 → 50
Pocus
Damage changed from 5 → 25

Cooldown changed from 4 → 6
Slowclaw
Damage changed from 30 → 75
Infernus
Health changed from 450 → 375

Attack Ignite stacks changed from 40 → 20
Shortfuse
Mana changed from 2 → 3

Radius changed from 8m → 4m
Blitzbois
Health changed from 85 → 125

Starting Damage changed from 1 → 20

Full Blitz Damage changed from 100 → 60
Badaboom
Mana changed from 4 → 6

Health changed from 200 → 150

Starting Damage changed from 1 → 25

Inner Radius Damage set to 250

Outer Radius Damage set to 25
Zip Zap
Fixed an issue where it would target and shoot through the floor
Floraphant
Health changed from 550 → 500

Full Blitz Damage changed from 400 → 300
Champions
Cooldowns are adjusted on champions to fit the flow of intended combat per champion better.

Jump velocities are lowered so champions stay in melee and sight range of other players better.

With this, we removed the horizontal slowdown from jump spamming

Scrap and talent pick-ups have been tweaked to be instant
Bolgar
Bolgar was stacking knockback power a little to much with talents and wildcards so we are bringing that down a little across the board.

Stampede talent knockback power changed from 5 → 3

Wide Bore talent knockback power changed from 5.5 → 4

Packleader's Boon talent now ignores himself

Can no longer jump while sprinting

Special ability damage changed from 5 → 20

Special ability cooldown changed from 15s → 20s

Jump velocity changed from 2800 → 1900

Melee damage from 15 → 20

Werebear damage from 20 → 30

Super Werebear from 30 → 40

Can now be knocked back in Super Werebear
Neva
We didn’t like how Neva could abuse the use of going in and out of her Ultimate, so we are changing when the Ultimate can be used.

We saw that the hack was not lasting long enough to be impactful, and at times would not reach where you thought it would.

Ultimate can no longer activate at 50%

Early Access talent changed from activating from 25% → 50%

Special ability mechanical hack duration changed from 4s → 6s

Special ability silence duration changed from 1.5s → 3s

Special ability range changed from 10m → 12.5m

Neva's special ability cooldown from 20s → 25s

Jump velocity changed from 1800 → 1550

Fixed an issue where Neva would get stuck with low gravity

Fixed an issue where Neva's mech would stay on the field

Fixed an issue where Neva would come out of her ultimate with XO on

Fixed an issue where you can move while transforming into the ultimate
Locke
Volt was being used a lot more than intended, with the amount of damage it was dealing. We want to slow the use of Volt but also change the base damage to do less per target. Whereas the talent to Crit will bring that damage up.

Volt damage from 50 → 25

Jump velocity changed from 1900 → 1800

Gravity changed from 4 → 5

Special ability cooldown from 25s → 20s

Movement ability cooldown from 8s → 10s

Sidekick ability cooldown from 15s → 22s

Fixed an issue where Locke’s melee would hit twice

Can now always jump, and you have to hold to hover

To stop hovering, you have to wait for the time to run out or use another ability

Fixed an issue where his ultimate would not charge

Fixed an issue where the ultimate would get canceled while activating
Ragna
We saw that Ragna was not keeping up with other champions as well as we wanted, so we are tuning the fire damage up on her across the board.

Dash ignite stacks changed from 9 → 15

Special ability ignite stacks changed from 25 → 45

Ultimate ignite stacks changed from 160 → 90 per hit

Now has 2 hits

First at 1.12s

Second at 2.3s

Jump velocity changed from 2800 → 2000

Fixed an issue where singe would stay around after a KO

notes.title: Alpha 3 is Here!
notes.content:
ALPHA 3 IS HERE!
We are kicking off playtesting for Alpha 3 this weekend, while the team is at LVL UP, and have extended playtest hours to get more players into the game! 

Extended Playtesting Hours for this Week:
4/25: 5pm - 11pm CST  (April 25, 10:00 PM – April 26, 4:00 AM UTC)
4/26 11am- 6pm CST  (April 26, 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM UTC)

PATCH NOTES  
4.25 Update  

GENERAL  
  
Can now see champion abilities in the TAB/Select screen in-game  
All dashes are immune to slows while dashing  
Players were experiencing getting double slowed, so using a dash to cleanse a slow was not working as intended.  
All Ultimates are immune to slows while activating  
Since ultimates are no longer immune to damage, if a player is slowed while using an ultimate, it’s too hard of a counter to shut it down and KO the player.  
Now immune when walking out of the dugout for 2 seconds  
Can cast and use abilities once having left the dugout  


WILDCARDS  
  
Changed from 5 → 3 in a deck  
When a Wildcard is captured, a 90-second timer will start  
If the timer runs out, the Wildcards are removed from the players  
If a player is KO’d, the Wildcards are removed from them  
If a player gets a KO, the timer is increased by 10 seconds  
If a player picks up a new Wildcard, the timer resets to 90 seconds  


CHAMPIONS

Neva  
  
Fixed bug with her getting stuck  
Fixed bug not being able to use Sidekick  
Fixed bug with XO not returning to her  


Hack Mechanic  
  
Hack no longer prevents summoning  


Dash  
  
Now cleanses slows  


Ultimate  
  
Now Hacks on activation  
Increased movement speed from 600 → 900  
Increased attack speed from 0.7 → 1  


Ragna  
Sidekick  
  
Changed from global → 50m  


SUMMONS

Vitadrop  
  
Lifelink healing changed from 50% → 100%  


Broc  
  
Lifelink healing changed from 50% → 100%  
Damage changed from 50 → 35  


Buckshot  
  
Each consecutive hit increases the damage done to a maximum of 100 per shot  
Starting damage is 40  
Increased damage per shot is 20  


Lumph  
  
Replaced instant Overheal with Overheal-over-time ability  
Increased total overhealing done to 100 HP over 5 seconds  


RB-IT  
  
Fixed a bug where dashing after being hit by RB-IT would not cleanse the Time Dilation  


Burnout  
  
Fire Trail duration decreased from 5 → 1 seconds  
Fire Trail damage increased from 35 → 50  


Skye  
  
Fixed to apply Overclocked all the time  
Fixed to cleanse slows  


Heartburn  
  
Increased fireball size (radius) by 50%  
Increased fireball travel speed by 10%  
Increased fireball damage 40 → 50  
Fireball now correctly deals FIRE damage  


GAMEPLAY EFFECTS  
The following effects no longer stack:  
  
Overclocked won't stack  
Enrage won't stack  
Time Dilation won't stack  


UI  
  
Deck building screen UI updated  
Champion select screen UI updated  


KNOWN ISSUES  
  
Goalie Health Bar  
On occasion, the goalie health bar will not reflect the damage the goalie has taken. It’s a HUD issue only — the goalie will take damage and be KO’d as expected.  

End of Match Rewards  
The rewards UI shown at the end of a match can show +0 coins. Coins are being awarded as expected, and the coin count does update to reflect your actual rewards.  

Challenges  
The Challenges UI may not update, even though your progress toward completing the challenge is being captured.  


We can't wait to see you in the arena and get your feedback! We appreciate your help!

notes.title: Alpha 2 is here!
notes.content:
Alpha 2 Patch Notes

Progression

Champion Mastery

 Updated Mastery Track Items

The mastery track levels are temporary and will be adjusted throughout Alpha

Account

 Update account level items

The account levels are temporary and will be adjusted throughout Alpha

Summons
Summon Mastery Track is as follows. Each level will adjust the cardʼs look and build on the previous level.

 Level 2 Metallic Frame Card
 Level 3 Frame Break Card
 Level 4 3D Card
 Level 5 Foil Card
 Level 6 Animated Card

Packs

 Rarity pull chance percentages adjusted
 Packs now have a guaranteed rarity associated with them
 Updated pack opening sequence
 New summon leveling sequence

Game Mode
Goalie

 Improved targeting behavior
 Increased health

Shield

 Increased health

Deck Building
 Overhaul of the deck building screen

 Now shows summon overview stats
 Now shows summon keywords
 Now shows summon 3D cards and visuals

 Added Champion Talents

Party System

 Can now add friends
 Can now create a party
 Can now queue as a party

Play Flow

 Updated to support 2v2 better
 Now shows your teammate in the selection lobby
 Can now select cosmetics for your champion

Combat
As we played more with the 2v2 we noticed there were some improvements and changes we needed to make to the overall flow and feel of the combat. It was not fully balanced yet or familiar enough to the players.

Camera and Champion Position

 Moved the champion position to the left of the center of the screen

 This is to give a better visual while fighting and throwing cards
 This allows us to use the center of the screen for combat and abilities in more ways


Ultimate Immunity

 Champions no longer get immunity frames while casting or using ultimate's

 We felt that the ultimates were being used in ways to just get immunity frames and avoid damage. This was also leading to the abilities being used in combat when they were not meant to be used that way.

Reticle

 Added a reticle so a player knows where they will attack
 All attacks and abilities now go to the center of the screen where the reticle is
 Hit marks when you hit something
 KO indication when you get a KO

Opponent Targeting

 Now has a white outline to show what opponent you will hit

Hit Notifications

 Increased the visuals to know when youʼre being hit or hitting something
 Hit marks on the reticle
 Screen flash
 HP bar shake

Health Bars

 Only shown if something is damaged

Damage Numbers

 Removed damage flyoffs in game

Outlines and Icons

 Improved outlines of opponents and teammates
 Updated icons to be team champions only

Champions
As we dove more into the 2v2 nature of the game we found we needed to make the champions fill a role more. You will find updates to the champions kits to reflect these changes. Each champion also has a more distinct sidekick passive.

Champion Details View

 By right clicking on a champion in deck selection you can see the details of a champion
 This will show the champions abilities
 You can now see the champions mastery track


Champion Talents

 Champions now have talents that can be unlocked by mastering them
 A deck can have 3 talents in them
 A talent is active on a champion for the whole match

Bolgar
House Lubabub

 Role: Bruiser
 Playstyle: Disruptor
 Difficulty: ⭐⭐
 Health Changed from 350 → 400
 Combo 1 Damage changed from 20 → 17
 Combo 2 Damage changed from 20 → 17
 Combo 3 Damage changed from 25 → 21

NEW Sidekick Passive: Bear Claws

 Each time Bolgar hits an opponent, a bleed is applied for 1 damage per second for 5 seconds
 This is to lean into him staying in the fight and pushing the health regen of other champions by another 5 seconds


Special: Logzooka

 Can now be used on the ground
 Aims to the reticle


Talents

 Healing Bounty

 Last hitting an opponent spawns a health pickup

 Stonebreaker

 Bolgarʼs dash knocks back opponents

 Shockwave Impact

 Gains increased KNOCKBACK power of Logzooka.

 NEW Reckless Charge

 Gains movement speed for a duration after using Shoulder Bash.

 NEW Earthshakerʼs Momentum

 Gains bonus attack damage for a duration after using an ability.

 NEW Thunder Paws

 Burr's attacks apply KNOCKBACK.

 NEW Bearʼs Fury

 When Burr is active, Bolgar becomes ENRAGED for a duration.

 NEW Resilient Roar

 Activating Werebear max heals all teammates around Werebear.

 NEW Dominant Presence

 Activating Werebear ENRAGES nearby teammates for a duration.


Locke
House Chronos

 Role: Duelist
 Playstyle: Skirmisher
 Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
 Health Changed from 175 → 200
 Movement Speed Changed from 1200 → 1250


NEW Sidekick Passive: Temporal Engine

 This allows Locke to lean more into the "glass cannonˮ skirmish play style
 Locke's engines gain power each time he deals damage and lose power each time he takes damage.
 Increases movement speed, attack speed and ultimate charge


Special: Hover

 We felt having the ability to slow opponents two times was not needed and that we could make the hover move valuable for Lockes playstyle
 Hovers in the air for a duration, evading opponents and maintaining his Temporal Engine status.
 Duration: 10 seconds
 Cooldown: 10 seconds
 This keeps you in the air long enough to get your health regen back


Dash: Chronowarp

 TIME DILATION (slowed time) duration changed from 2 seconds → 3 seconds


Ultimate: Full Send

 Changed from 260 seconds → 190 seconds


Talents

 NEW Freeflow Channeling

 Activating Full Send causes the next card used to cost 0 Mana.

 NEW Resourceful Engineer

 When a card is played there is a chance that card is kept in hand.

 NEW Gear Infusion

 Basic attacks have a chance to apply TIME DIALATION on the third hit.

 Thunderous Decent

 TIME DIALATION duration increased on dash.

 Chain Lightning

 Volt's attack has a chance to deal CRITICAL damage to opponents.

 NEW Aetherial Burst

 Gains OVERSHIELD when using Hover.

 Evasive Engineering

 Gains OVERSHIELD after using Chronowarp.

 NEW Chrono Surge

 Full Send charges faster.

 NEW Ultimate Harvest

 Last hitting an opponent spawns an ultimate charge pickup.


Ragna
House Malus

 Role: Bruiser
 Playstyle: Brawler
 Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐


Special: Fire Kick

 Fire damage changed from 30 → 45


Sidekick: Singe

 Cooldown changed from 90 seconds → 60 seconds


Dash: Trail

 Fire Damage changed from 10 → 15


Ultimate: Flashfire

 Ultimate changed from 100 → 80
 10 stacks of fire damage added to ultimate


Ultimate Charge: Pyromancer

 Fire Damage Charge Rate changed from 2 per tick → 1 per tick


Talents

 NEW Combustion Surge

 Trail count increased to 5.

 NEW Inferno Mastery

 Activating Singe heals Ragna and teammates.

 Flame Rebirth

 On last hit ragna auto heals

 NEW Eternal Embers

 Singe Cooldown is reduced.

 NEW Flame Weaving

 Activating Singe IGNITES all opponents on the field.

 Phoenix Dive

 After using air attack ragna gains temp movement speed

 NEW Ember Pack

 Singe EMPOWERS for more damage when activated.

 Searing Bonds

 The duration singe is active is increased

 NEW Blazing Decent

 Gains EMPOWERED after activating Fire Kick.


Neva
House Chronos

 Role: Duelist
 Playstyle: Fighter
 Difficulty: ⭐⭐⭐⭐
 Combo 1 Damage changed from 45 → 35
 Combo 2 Damage changed from 45 → 35
 Attack Speed 1 → 0.75 (Slower)


Sidekick: XO

 Support Bot

 Health 150 → 50
 Haste 20% → 10%

 Melee Bot

 Health 250 → 175

 Turret Bot

 Health 350 → 100
 Damage 25 → 20
 Range 30m → 25m



Special: EMP

 HACKS or SUPPRESSES opponents in an area for a duration.
 Hack turns the mechanical summons to your side for a duration
 Suppresses makes the non mechanical summons and champions not be able to use abilities for a duration
 Cooldown 35 → 30


Dash: Rollout

 Neva rolls forward, applying Haste to any teammates hit.


Ultimate: Mechanized

 Activation changed from needing 1% → 50%


Sidekick Passive: XO Armor

 XO becomes Neva's exoskeleton providing her with more health and damage.
 Neva no longer heals to full health when she regains XO.
 When Neva regains XO, she keeps her organic health regeneration state.


Talents

 Neva Talent 1

 Range and duration of EMP is increased.

 Neva Talent 2

 Support Bot gains increased health and provides increased OVERCLOCKED.

 Neva Talent 3

 Neva can activate Mechanized at 25% charge.

 Neva Talent 4

 Ranged Bot gains increased health and increased RANGE.

 Neva Talent 5

 Activating Mechanized creates an EMP.

 Neva Talent 6

 Solo Neva gains CRITICAL damage.

 Neva Talent 7

 Neva gains OVERCLOCKED for a duration after XO returns from being broken.

 Neva Talent 8

 XO gains decreased return duration.

 Neva Talent 9

 Melee Bot gains increased health and increased damage.



Summons
All summons have had a pass on them. We felt that they needed changes and enhancements to them to fill the role they are meant to fill. These are the updated summon descriptions:

Shooticrue

 Three RANGED drones.


Sembler

 SPAWNS Shooticrue over time gradually taking WEAR & TEAR damage.
 Sembler FLEES when attacked.


Beakit

 Attacks pass through and damage opponents.


Skye

 Creates a field of OVERCLOCKED (sped up time).


Wotchy

 Guards an area by going out and attacking any opponents within his sight.
 Gradually takes WEAR & TEAR damage.


Deadeye

 Attacks from a RANGE gradually taking WEAR & TEAR damage. Deadeye FLEES when attacked.


Chonodrop

 ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Creates a field of TIME DILATION when it attacks.


Fendor

 ON SUMMON, provides an OVERSHIELD to teammates.


Janz

 ON SUMMON creates a field of TIME DILATION and damages any opponents in range.


Razorpaw

 ACCELERATES over time dealing CRITICAL damge on impact.


RBIT

 Applies TIME DILATION with it's attacks.


TDPL

 UPGRADES, increasing the amount of TDPL summoned.


Zipzap

 Attacks from a RANGE increasing the damage dealt over time.


Shellshock

 Randomly targets opponents with its RANGED attack taking decreased damage while reloading.


Flingshot

 Immobile vent. Gradually takes WEAR & TEAR damage.


Lumph

 ON SUMMON, overheals any teammates in range.


Vitadrop

 ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Deals LIFELINK damage when it attacks.


Slowclaw

 Swipes its opponents dealing KNOCKBACK.


Hornelius

 KNOCKSBACK its opponents with its attacks.


Gorrit

 ON SUMMON, KNOCKSBACK and damages any opponents in range.


Aloe

 Heals teammates from a RANGE finding a new teammate once the current one is fully healed.


Spord

 Gradually SPAWNS Trooplets over time.


Chonk

 TAUNTS its opponents.


Pocus

 Attacks from a RANGE dealing KNOCKBACK.


Buckshot

 Attacks from a RANGE.


Broc

 Deals LIFELINK damage.


Cactiking

 Throws Cacticrue at its opponents from a RANGE. Has THORNS.


Floraphant

 TRAMPLES and has BLITZ.


Cacticrue

 Three Cacti with THORNS.


Furble

 TAUNTS opponents and then FLEES.


Badaboom

 ACCELERATES over time and has BLITZ. ON KO, leaves 4 Punks.


Lavadrop

 ON SUMMON attacks immeadiately if opponents are in range. Creates a lava pool when it attacks.


Heartburn

 Attacks at a RANGE.


D.F.A.

 SKILLSHOT, deals damage in a small area.


Magmalisk

 IGNITES with its attacks.


Tailblazer

 Ignites its opponents with a RANGED attack.


Burnout

 ON SUMMON, ZOOMS leaving a trail of lava behind.


Pyrokeet

 Attacks at a RANGE and has REBIRTH.


Punks

 Five RANGED Punks.


Grumph

 ON SUMMON, ENRAGES any teammates in range.


Volcrab

 Gradually SPAWNS Lavadrops over time.


Blitzbois

 IGNITES opponents and has BLITZ.


Infernus

 ON SUMMON, creates a lava pool. ATTACKS from a RANGE and IGNITES.


Shortfuse

 Attacks from a RANGE dealing damage in an area.
 Known Issues: Has no summon animation and can get stuck upon being summoned


Rekkit

 ON KO, leaves one Punk.


Gameplay Effects

Haste

 Decreased haste percent from 20% → 10%


Enrage

 Changed to only increase damage dealt


Controls

Controller (UPDATED)

 X → Special Ability
 A → Jump
 B → Dash
 Y → Sidekick
 RT → Attack
 LT → Throw Card (Hold to Aim)
 RB → Change active card
 LB → Change active card
 L3 → Interact
 LB+RB → Ultimate
 Select → Information Screen


Keyboard and Mouse (UPDATED)

 Left Mouse → Attack
 SPACE → Jump
 SHIFT → Dash
 F → Special Ability
 E → Sidekick
 Right Mouse → Throw a card. Hold to Aim.
 Mouse Wheel → Change active card
 1 → Select Card Slot 1
 2 → Select Card Slot 2
 3 → Select Card Slot 3
 4 → Select Card Slot 4
 R → Interact
 Q → Ultimate
 TAB → Information Screen

notes.title: Another Batch of Players Join the Wildcard Closed Alpha!
notes.content:

Hey Wildcard fans!

Big news: The second wave of invites to the Wildcard Closed Alpha Playtest has just gone out! If you’ve been selected, check your Steam notifications—you’ll see access to add the Wildcard Playtest to your Steam library and jump in. You’ll also receive an email from Steam with more details.

Alpha 1 Playtest Server Schedule:
 • Friday 3/21 @ 7pm ET (an hour after usual schedule)
 • Saturday 3/22 @ 12pm ET

We’re keeping the cadence going—playtests will continue to run on Fridays (6pm ET) and Saturdays (12pm ET) as we roll out additional waves of invites and expand access each week.

Haven’t received your invite yet? Don’t worry, more are on the way! Make sure you’re following Wildcard here on Steam and in our community spaces to stay in the loop.

For everyone hopping in this weekend: welcome! We can’t wait to hear your feedback, see your strategies, and shape the future of Wildcard together.

Wanna join the Wild family? Got questions? Come hang with us in Discord!
